Mild hypothermia activates a coordinated cellular response rather than simply slowing metabolism.
We study how this response reshapes mitochondrial function, RNA regulation and muscle-cell
differentiation, with particular attention to the cold-shock protein RBM3.

## Biological focus

By following cells during cooling and recovery, we examine how protective programmes are established,
maintained and reversed. This work provides a mechanistic basis for asking whether aspects of cold
adaptation can be used to improve tissue resilience without prolonged cooling.
